title: Grade 2 Math — Thu, Jun 19
description: Time — Day 4 of 5: AM and PM, time in daily life
subject: mathematics

questions.question: AM means ___.
questions.explanation: AM = times from 12 midnight to 12 noon (morning hours).

questions.question: PM means ___.
options: times from noon to midnight (afternoon and evening)
questions.explanation: PM = times from 12 noon to 12 midnight (afternoon, evening, night).

questions.question: Priya wakes up at 6:30 ___.
questions.explanation: Waking up in the morning = AM. 6:30 AM is morning time.

questions.question: Dinner is at 8:00 PM. That is in the ___.
questions.explanation: 8:00 PM is in the evening. PM covers afternoon through night.

questions.question: School starts at 8:00 AM and ends at 2:30 PM. How long is the school day?
questions.explanation: 8:00 AM to 2:00 PM = 6 hours. Plus 30 more minutes = 6 hours 30 minutes.

questions.question: Which activity happens at PM?
questions.explanation: 9:00 PM is night-time. Brushing teeth before bed is a PM activity.

questions.question: Midday (12 noon) is ___.
questions.explanation: 12 noon is 12 PM. It marks the end of AM and the start of PM.

questions.question: Midnight is ___.
questions.explanation: Midnight (12 midnight) is 12 AM. It marks the end of PM and the start of AM.

questions.question: A child goes to sleep at 9:00 PM and wakes up at 6:00 AM. How many hours did the child sleep?
questions.explanation: 9 PM to 6 AM: 9 PM to 12 AM = 3 hours; 12 AM to 6 AM = 6 hours. Total = 9 hours.

questions.question: Arrange the times in order from earliest to latest: (A) 7:00 AM  (B) 12:00 PM  (C) 3:00 PM  (D) 6:00 AM
questions.explanation: 6:00 AM → 7:00 AM → 12:00 PM → 3:00 PM. Earlier AM first.

questions.question: Anita has lunch at 1:15 PM. Lunch is in the ___.
questions.explanation: 1:15 PM is early afternoon. PM hours start at noon.

questions.question: If a movie starts at 7:00 PM and is 2 hours long, it ends at ___.
Which time is an AM time?
questions.explanation: 11:30 AM is before noon — an AM time.

questions.question: Rohan naps from 2:00 PM to 3:30 PM. How long is his nap?
questions.explanation: 2:00 PM to 3:30 PM = 1 hour and 30 minutes.

questions.question: There are ___ hours from 12 midnight to 12 noon.
questions.explanation: Midnight (12 AM) to noon (12 PM) = 12 hours. These are the AM hours.
